payload.name: YOLOv12-Enhanced valve nozzle detection
payload.fact: The YOLOv12-Enhanced model achieves 71.0% mAP50 and 54.4% mAP5095 in industrial valve nozzle detection, outperforming the baseline YOLOv12n.

provenance.title: YOLOv12-enhanced: multi-scale attention and edge information fusion for industrial valve nozzle detection
provenance.quote_or_locus: Experimental evaluation on the Pascal VOC dataset shows that the proposed model achieves 71.0% mAP50 and 54.4% mAP5095 under identical training conditions, exceeding the baseline YOLOv12n
